Buen lugar, buenos empleados, y hasta buenos baños, pena que de noche el sector de baños , tanto de hombre como el de mujeres es lugar de reunion de drogadictos y  de los trapitos(cuida coches) que te da miedo entrar al baño.

(Translated by Google)
Good place, good employees, and even good bathrooms, it's a shame that at night the bathroom area, both men's and women's, is a meeting place for drug addicts and parking attendants, making you afraid to enter the bathroom.
